title: Swiss Dwellings v3.0.0 (Archilyse)
notes: 45k apartments in 3,184 real multi-storey buildings: rooms, walls, windows, doors, fixtures, storeys with elevations. Local coordinates (published without positions). Areas checked against source plans (median deviation 1.2%).

title: ResPlan: 17,000 residential floor plans
notes: Single-level residential units in metres from real-estate listings; rooms by kind, walls, doors, windows, front door. Takedown process in the repository's TAKEDOWN.md.

title: CubiCasa5K
notes: 5,000 Finnish plans as images with SVG annotation, no metric scale. Non-commercial and share-alike: stripped at the commercial transition. Not downloaded: without a scale its rooms cannot be matched to a building's metres.

title: RPLAN
notes: 80k Asian apartment plans; released on request under a research agreement.

title: Structured3D
notes: 3.5k synthetic houses with full 3D; terms of use must be agreed before download.

title: Zillow Indoor Dataset
notes: 1.5k real homes with panoramas and floor plans; access by application.
